name: 乖乖鹄
evolution: 乖乖鹄 → 蓝珠天鹅 Lv.20 → 翠顶夫人 Lv.40；乖乖鹄 → 蓝珠天鹅 Lv.20 → 黑羽夫人 Lv.40
evolutionEn: Guaiguaihu → Lanzhutiane Lv.20 → Cuidingfuren Lv.40; Guaiguaihu → Lanzhutiane Lv.20 → Heiyufuren Lv.40
description: 羽毛有很好的疏水性，可以毫不费力地浮在水面上，浮着的时候怔怔地看着水面，并不是在发呆，而是在检查自己的美丽，小小的乖乖鹄很早就已经意识到了美丽与优雅的重要性。
descriptionEn: Its feathers have good water repellency and it can float on the water surface effortlessly. While floating, it stares blankly at the water, not daydreaming but checking its own beauty. The little Guaiguaihu has long been aware of the importance of beauty and elegance.
